title: Book One · Chapter 152: Bo Reads the Card
story:
Bo meets Ronan outside Mr Qiu's table. He is carrying a book under his arm. Mr Han stands a little way off with the red bicycle.

Ronan sees the bicycle before he sees the man's face. He knows that red colour at once. It is the bicycle his dad sold. Then Bo calls his name, and he looks at his friend.

“What have you got?” Bo asks.

Ronan has three street-game cards. He is bringing them for Mr Qiu to check. He gives Bo the easiest one first. It shows Mr Qiu's table. People buy pencils there.

Bo looks at the table and laughs. “Very hard.”

“Then try this.”

The second card has the green gate. The third asks about the closed grey door. Bo reads slowly. One word stops him. Ronan wants to say it, but Bo lifts a finger and tries again.

He gets it on the second try. Then he looks up.

“I don't know the answer.”

“We don't either. People can give us their answers.”

“Then you need somewhere to write it.”

Ronan looks at the cards. They have a game, a map, and a blank question. They do not have a place for answers yet.

Mr Qiu hears them. He takes out a plain pad. He made its cover from the rain-marked paper.

“A pad can wait beside that door.”

He offers to lend it for the afternoon. “May visitors write in it?” Ronan asks. Mr Qiu says yes. They must keep the pages together. They can copy the useful notes after the display. Then they must give the pad back.

Ronan writes that on his list. Bo reads another clue. He chooses the wrong door first. Two drawings have the same sign. Ronan makes a small mark to tell Leo. Bo did not help make this game. Now he has found a problem in their game. Ronan writes it down for Leo.

Mr Han comes closer. He asks about River Street Day. Ronan gives him a plain invitation. The man reads the time. He must check their plans for that afternoon. They may be able to come.

He does not offer the red bicycle for the display. Ronan does not ask. The Han family owns the bicycle now. Ronan does not need it in the school room. He goes on talking to Bo.

Bo walks beside him for a short way. Mr Han walks slowly behind them with the bicycle. They each have a book to read. They talk about those books. Bo likes pictures with animals. Ronan likes a story about two boys. They are trying to find a boat. One page is still hard for him to read.

“Will you explain every answer yourself?” Bo asks. Ronan says Leo made the game and will be there at the start. Bo nods. He would like to ask Leo about the joke door. Ronan smiles. Bo and Leo can talk about the game themselves. Ronan can leave them to talk about it together.

At the corner Bo turns back. Ronan waves, then goes on to the green gate with his cards.

He sees his bell on the low shelf when he puts the list away. It will not go to school either. He wants to keep the bell at home. It is his bell. He can make that choice himself. The bell can wait at home until there is a bicycle for it.

At supper he tells Dad about Bo finding the problem in the game. “Which door was wrong?” Dad asks. Ronan gets the cards and shows him. They look at the drawings together, while the old bell stays quietly on its shelf.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：invitation＝邀请卡；clue＝游戏提示；copy＝抄写。

情节提示：pad＝便笺本；clue＝提示；blank＝空白的。

理解：1. Bo 帮游戏发现了哪两个实际问题？2. 红自行车和车铃这次各留在哪里？
